baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural imperative on m-y-z and the direct vocative identifying the addressees as mujrimun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command applies separation to a culpable class: an implicit mixed population is sorted until the addressed group stands apart.

activation_trace.role: Sorting until unlike elements become distinct supplies the literal separation and makes the imperative a group-partition operation.
Offense and culpability supply the literal class label and the criterion by which the addressed group is partitioned.

changed_reading.after: Be sorted out as a culpable collective from those with whom you are mixed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Mujrimun carries both acquisition and offense branches of j-r-m beside the sorting imperative.
baseline_models.mechanism: The acquisition and offense branches form a possible causal sequence: what the addressees earned has hardened into the status by which they are separated.

activation_trace.role: Sorting supplies the classificatory action that turns a difference into a visibly separate group.
Acquisition supplies a history of getting or earning and functions as the process that produced the class.
Culpable offense supplies the resulting status into which those acquisitions are classified.

changed_reading.before: The label criminals merely names a fixed group.
changed_reading.after: Those who acquired culpability are made to stand as the class their own earning produced.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-yawm stands between the imperative of separation and a j-r-m address whose inventory includes completed time.
baseline_models.mechanism: The severe-event branch of y-w-m and the completed-term branch of j-r-m make separation a terminal threshold rather than ordinary spatial movement.

activation_trace.role: A severe event supplies the qualitative force of today and turns the time marker into a decisive occurrence.
A span reaching completion supplies expiry and makes the addressed status coincide with the end of a term.
Definitive sorting supplies the boundary crossed when that term ends.

changed_reading.after: At the severe event where your term reaches completion, pass irreversibly out of the mixed order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The m-y-z imperative can activate the branch of intellectual discrimination, while j-r-m can activate acquisition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command can demand recognition as well as movement: the addressed earners are made to distinguish the culpable identity their acquisitions have produced.

activation_trace.role: The faculty that extracts meanings supplies discernment and makes the imperative potentially reflexive and cognitive.
Acquisition supplies what must be recognized as having formed the addressees' present identity.

changed_reading.after: Distinguish and recognize yourselves now as the earners of the status by which you are addressed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal gathering and presence establish one assembled field; companionship and pairing then characterize one cohort before the focus command extracts the culpable cohort. Separation therefore removes relation and membership as well as location.

activation_trace.role: Sorting until groups stand distinct supplies the second-stage partition of an already assembled population.
Joining dispersed elements into one whole supplies the common assembly from which the focus group can be extracted.
Presence and proximity place the gathered total in one adjudicative field before differentiation.
Companionship and continued association supply the relational cohesion retained by the immediately contrasted cohort.
A companion joined to its counterpart supplies paired belonging, sharpening separation as exclusion from joined relation.

structural_cues: 36:53 gathers all into presence; 36:54 applies recompense to every soul; 36:55-58 depicts a companioned and paired cohort immediately before the vocative command in 36:59.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common assembly, then companioned pairing, then separation; I infer a two-stage sorting with relational asymmetry. A live alternative is a simple change of addressee with no encoded sorting procedure.

changed_reading.before: A criminal group is told to move away.
changed_reading.after: From the total already gathered into presence, the culpable cohort is extracted and deprived of the companionship and pairing that mark the contrasting cohort.

context_deltas.mechanism: Registration, persistent traces, exhaustive counting, action-matched recompense, testimony, and earnings form an audit pipeline. The acquisition branch of j-r-m becomes the process, its offense branch becomes the verdict, and m-y-z executes the resulting classification.

activation_trace.role: Sorting supplies the final operation that materializes an evidentiary classification.
Earning and acquisition supply the conduct accumulated by the addressees.
Culpable offense supplies the verdict into which the accumulated conduct is converted.
Entering a name into a register or class supplies the administrative form of classification.
A persisting mark that reveals what occurred supplies durable evidence rather than an unsupported label.
Exhaustive numerical accounting supplies completeness to the evidentiary record.
Matching an action with its return supplies the rule that converts recorded conduct into outcome.
Intentional action supplies the assessable conduct to which recompense is matched.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies direct testimony that makes the classification publicly inspectable.
Seeking and acquiring gain supplies a contextual echo of j-r-m acquisition and closes the causal chain from earning to status.

structural_cues: 36:12 records prior acts and their traces; 36:54 limits recompense to what was done; 36:65 makes the body testify to what was earned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies records, traces, exact recompense, testimony, and earning; I infer that mujrimun is the disclosed result of this audit and that separation enforces it. Alternatively, the label may be preassigned while the evidence only justifies punishment.

changed_reading.before: Criminals is a static label attached before the command.
changed_reading.after: The recorded earners are sorted into the culpable class that their surviving traces, matched deeds, and testimony disclose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeatedly announced appointment and threat becomes present as today, while sealing marks arrival at an endpoint. The completed-time branch of j-r-m turns the focus command into enforcement at an expired term.

activation_trace.role: The severe event supplies today with the force of a decisive occurrence rather than a neutral date.
A period reaching completion supplies the expired term at which separation becomes irreversible.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the deferred deadline whose arrival today resolves the challenge.
A threatened promise supplies the adverse content now being enforced at the deadline.
The repeated severe-event time marker carries the focus today directly into the stated consequence.
Reaching the end and completing a seal supplies closure to both the term and the opportunity to answer.

structural_cues: 36:48 asks when the promise will occur; 36:52 identifies its arrival; 36:63 names the promised consequence; 36:64-65 repeat today and move into consequence and sealing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a deferred appointment, its announced arrival, repeated today, and a seal; I infer expiry and closure as the directional link. A live alternative is that today remains purely deictic and the following seal begins a separate procedure.

changed_reading.before: Separate at the time designated as today.
changed_reading.after: Separate now because the threatened appointment has matured, the severe event has arrived, and your allotted term is being closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failures of sight, path recognition, and reason surround the focus. The intellectual-discrimination branch of m-y-z is therefore reversed: those who did not distinguish the path are no longer agents of discernment but objects of an imposed distinction.

activation_trace.role: The faculty of extracting meanings supplies the discernment that the surrounding sequence portrays as failed.
External sorting supplies the imposed counterpart to the discernment that was not exercised.
Physical seeing supplies the early image of perceptual access that the addressees lack.
The straight road supplies the object that should have been recognized and followed.
Deviation from guidance supplies the failed choice that precedes imposed classification.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance supplies the unused capacity corresponding to m-y-z discernment.
The later inability to see the road closes the visual frame and makes external sorting replace self-directed recognition.

structural_cues: 36:9 denies sight before the warnings; 36:61 identifies the straight path; 36:62 asks about reason after misguidance; 36:66 again joins the path to inability to see.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed vision, a straight path, misguidance, and failed reason; I infer a reversal from voluntary discernment to involuntary distinction. Alternatively, these cues may only describe moral blindness while imtazu remains wholly spatial.

changed_reading.before: Distinguish and recognize your acquired culpable identity.
changed_reading.after: Because discernment and sight failed, the distinction is now imposed on the offenders as a visible sorting they no longer control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verses after the focus specify a preserved covenant and two opposed obediences, one directed toward an enemy and one along the straight path. The separation criterion thus sharpens from unspecified crime to acquired relational allegiance across a covenant boundary.

activation_trace.role: Sorting supplies the visible boundary between opposed alignments.
Acquisition supplies the history of chosen allegiance that produces the separated status.
Culpable transgression supplies the juridical character of crossing the covenant boundary.
A preserved covenant supplies the prior relational norm against which the class is distinguished.
Submissive obedience supplies the prohibited allegiance that locates one side of the boundary.
Enmity supplies the adverse relation that makes the prohibited obedience a breach rather than a neutral affiliation.
Submissive obedience supplies the opposed allegiance on the other side of the sorting boundary.
The straight road supplies the spatialized norm along which the alternative allegiance is ordered.

structural_cues: The focus vocative is followed immediately by a recalled covenant addressed to the children of Adam, a prohibition and command using the same obedience root, and identification of the straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a covenant and opposed obediences; I infer that allegiance is the specific relation whose breach is exposed by separation. Alternatively, these verses may explain one major offense without making allegiance the sole sorting criterion.

changed_reading.before: The culpable group separates under an unspecified criminal classification.
changed_reading.after: Those whose acquired obedience crossed the preserved covenant are made to stand on the enemy-aligned side of a now-visible relational boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single cry gathers the total, while the surah's final command pattern joins authoritative demand, utterance, and immediate occurrence. The focus imperative can therefore function as an effective decree that produces the partition it names.

activation_trace.role: Sorting supplies the state of affairs brought about by the imperative.
A high voice supplies an earlier utterance-like event whose occurrence immediately reorganizes the population into presence.
Binding demand supplies the authoritative force that makes the focus imperative more than advice.
Spoken utterance supplies the verbal channel through which the commanded state is effected.
Occurrence in time supplies immediate realization as the result of authoritative speech.

structural_cues: 36:53 moves from one cry to universal presence; 36:59 is a bare plural imperative; 36:82 closes the surah with command, utterance, and immediate occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech-events that reorganize reality and a final command-to-occurrence formula; I infer analogous performative force for the focus imperative. A live alternative is that 36:82 describes creative command generally and does not determine the pragmatics of 36:59.

changed_reading.before: The addressees receive an instruction to carry out separation.
changed_reading.after: The authoritative address itself effects the partition, making the criminals distinct in the act of commanding them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the neck-extension branch of m-y-z is rare and distant from the ordinary plural imperative. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and is locally activated by the packet's neck, collar, chin, and raised-head cluster in 36:8. Downstream prose should render it only as a punitive posture echo, not as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The m-y-z imperative carries the branch of extending the neck in an address to one marked for a blow.

activation_trace.role: Extending or presenting the neck supplies the rare punitive posture that colors how the separated group files out.
The physical neck supplies the body locus needed to anchor the focus branch's posture.
A collar that binds an organ supplies coercion and prevents the raised posture from reading as voluntary display.
The meeting point of the jaws supplies the upper bodily endpoint toward which the restraint presses.
Raising the head supplies the visible stance that lets the rare focus branch reappear as a punishment-line echo.

changed_reading.before: The criminals are told to stand separately.
changed_reading.after: The criminals file out as a marked punishment line, with the earlier coerced raised-neck posture faintly reactivated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates cutting and post-harvest residue branches inside mujrimun and sifting branches inside the palm root. It remains anchored in both focus roots and gains a sequence from grain and fruit to the non-dominant j-z-z mapping at recompense. Downstream prose should qualify it as an agricultural sorting overlay, not claim that mujrimun lexically means crop residue.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins m-y-z sorting to the j-r-m branches of cutting and what remains after harvest.

activation_trace.role: Sorting until elements stand apart supplies the post-harvest separation operation.
Cutting and harvesting supply the operation that creates a separated remainder.
Dry fruit and remnants left after cutting supply the image of a residual class after harvest.
Seed that sprouts and bears grain supplies the beginning of the crop sequence whose endpoint can be sorting.
Sifting flour supplies a hidden separation image within the cultivated palm cue.
Selecting the best supplies evaluative sorting within the same agricultural root inventory.
Ripe fruit supplies the mature yield immediately available for taking and division.
The non-dominant mapped branch of ripeness reaching cutting time bridges action-matched recompense to the harvest image.

changed_reading.before: The culpable group is separated from a human assembly.
changed_reading.after: At recompense the group is also imagable, cautiously, as the cut-off remainder sorted when the surah's crop reaches its time of harvest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the body branch of j-r-m beside the tearing branch of m-y-z and lets social separation penetrate the person. It remains anchored in exact focus branches and is activated by independently testifying hands and feet, bodily transformation, and decayed bones. Downstream prose should present it as a corporeal accountability overlay, not substitute body for the ordinary culpability sense of mujrimun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus permits a collision between m-y-z tearing apart and j-r-m bodily mass.

activation_trace.role: Being pulled apart until fragmentation supplies internal rather than merely intergroup separation.
Bodily mass supplies the material unit whose organs can be separated into distinct witnesses.
The hand as a bodily organ supplies one independently speaking component of the accountable body.
The foot as a bodily organ supplies a second component whose testimony distributes agency across the body.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the evidentiary function assigned to the separated organs.
Earning organs supply a direct bridge between bodily members and the acquisitions for which they testify.
Transformation and deformation of bodily form supply the possibility that accountable identity need not preserve its ordinary shape.
Hard bone supplies the durable material remainder of the body after disaggregation.
Decay supplies the terminal fragmented condition from which bodily accountability is nevertheless recoverable.

changed_reading.before: A culpable social class is separated from other people.
changed_reading.after: Cautiously, separation also enters each culpable body: its organs become distinct witnesses while its material identity remains recoverable through transformation and decay.

strongest_changes: Universal gathering turns the focus into a second-stage partition, with companionship retained on one side and relational exclusion imposed on the other.
Records, traces, exact recompense, testimony, and earning turn mujrimun from a static label into the disclosed result of an evidentiary process.
The promised appointment, repeated today, and subsequent seal turn separation into enforcement at a completed term.
Failed vision and reason reverse possible self-discernment into a distinction imposed from outside.
The surah's command-to-occurrence pattern makes the imperative readable as an effective decree, not only an instruction.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly joined then split, recorded then embodied, and promised then sealed. Rare focus branches also found local somatic and agricultural support, including the non-dominant j-z-z mapping at 36:54, without requiring those overlays to replace the ordinary reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The cognitive and raised-neck branches of m-y-z may be active echoes rather than semantic components of the imperative.
The completed-time, harvest, and bodily branches of j-r-m are visibly supported but remain form-distant and should not displace the culpability branch.
The performative force inferred from 36:82 may describe divine command generally without transferring fully to the pragmatics of 36:59.
The covenant sequence strongly supplies an allegiance boundary, but it may specify one offense rather than the exhaustive criterion for the separated class.
